scopeStatement: This evidence proves that a real local n8n runtime (v2.35.7, Docker) genuinely executed both committed Lead Rescue workflows (n8n/workflows/lead-rescue-ingress.json via a real webhook delivery, n8n/workflows/lead-rescue-wait-sweep.json via its own Schedule Trigger firing unattended) and crossed the real Lead Rescue application HTTP boundary, producing durable application state through the real file-backed persistence layer. It does NOT prove real Anthropic classification — the decision provider was fixture-backed for this capture, never the live ClaudeDecisionProvider. It does NOT prove real outbound third-party message delivery — no email, SMS, or CRM provider was contacted; every side effect this capture touched remains simulated, and no production credential, endpoint, or deployment exists anywhere in this path.
